_readme: Stock Cockpit settings. Universe = liquid US common stocks; regime = risk gauge from trend, breadth and VIX; earnings and short interest as catalysts. Your watchlist lives in docs/watchlist.json and is edited from the dashboard.

setups._note: The Screener's event lists, same rules as its lenses.py/notify.py, re-priced live. Scores come from docs/screener.json (tools/export_screener.py on the laptop).

premarket._note: Pre-market scan, 4:00-9:30 New York, every 15 minutes: alert on stocks up this much vs yesterday's close with at least this much traded (full-market data, 15 minutes delayed).
